# Matimo

> Matimo is an MIT-licensed, policy-governed tool-execution SDK for AI agents. Every tool call — built-in, third-party, or agent-created — passes through a policy engine (risk classification, deterministic security rules, human-in-the-loop approval) before it executes. Dual TypeScript and Python implementation with feature parity; one YAML tool definition runs across TypeScript, Python, LangChain, CrewAI, Agno, and MCP.

Install: `npm install @matimo/core` (TypeScript) or `pip install matimo` (Python). Provider packages install separately, e.g. `npm install @matimo/slack` / `pip install matimo-slack`. CLI: `npm install -g @matimo/cli`.

Core capabilities: 139+ production tools across 10 first-party provider packages (Slack, Gmail, GitHub, Notion, HubSpot, Postgres, Twilio, Mailchimp, Microsoft Graph, Bruno), plus a governed 449-tool Composio catalog; 15 meta-tools for runtime self-extension (`matimo_create_tool`, `matimo_approve_tool`, `matimo_create_skill`, `matimo_reload_tools`, and 11 more); a policy engine with 9 deterministic content rules, risk classification (low/medium/high/critical), per-call human approval (secure by default since 0.2.0: DELETE and command tools ask), HITL quarantine, HMAC-signed approvals, events and a hash-chained audit log; a first-party MCP server (stdio + Streamable HTTP) compatible with Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Windsurf.

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): setup/build/test commands and conventions for AI coding agents working in this repository
